en: The image shows a historical black-and-white scene with several people, mostly men, in traditional Mongolian and Russian attire. They are gathered in an open yard surrounded by stacks of large crates or bales, possibly tea bricks. Some individuals appear to be weighing or inspecting the goods using a simple tripod scale. The setting looks like a trading or reception area, likely for tea trade. The top of the postcard has text in Russian and French, mentioning Siberia and the reception of tea from the Mongols.
